args.content: Here is what I completed and what I could not do without a steer. Completed: I deleted the three DataForge emails from the vendor we offboarded, namely the final invoice, the data export notice, and the account closure, plus the team offsite receipt and the press query email. I updated Karthik Iyer, who wrote the ledger-service RFC, to Principal Engineer; set Kavya Nair's city to Bengaluru; changed Tara Menon, our recruiter, to Talent Lead; bumped Ananya Iyer, who organizes the Analytics review, to Senior Data Scientist; and set Thomas George, our office manager, to Workplace Experience Lead per his start note. I added a 30-minute Design sync on August 15 at 3 PM with Arjun Rao, our design lead; a 45-minute Budget review on August 14 at 11 AM with Harish Gupta and Lata Pillai; and a 60-minute Vendor transition review on August 20 at 2 PM with Imran Sheikh at CloudSpan and Priya Menon in operations. I messaged Rhea Kapoor, our QA engineer, on our one-on-one that release 2.4 is good to ship; posted in the Pinewicket Product Pod that the design review moved to Friday; and confirmed in the Design Guild that the component library review is on for Thursday. I replied to Nikhil Desai's fundraise intro follow-up that the deck goes to the intros this week; to Tara Menon's candidate shortlist that the onsite panel is good to schedule; to Aisha Khan, who organizes the Q3 board meeting, that the deck is ready; and to Mohit Verma's pen-test findings that we are cleared to publish. On the chained items: I set Divya Menon, who is taking over customer success per the CS Guild chat, to Head of Customer Success, replied to her onboarding plan to approve the rollout, and added the 45-minute CS kickoff on August 23 at 3 PM with her and Priya Menon in operations that the plan asked for; I set Rohan Kulkarni, who organizes the Partnerships review, to Head of Partnerships and replied to his FinBridge pilot intro to go ahead; and I set Nidhi Kapoor, the security lead running the compliance audit, to Head of Security and messaged her on our one-on-one that the audit is cleared to start. Could not do, and I did not guess on any: (1) two chats share the exact title Catch-up and Startup Updates, so the startup catch-up note has no single target; (2) the quarterly review has no resolvable date, next Tuesday has no anchor, and no time; (3) no email is from a Priya about the Q3 budget, the Priyas wrote about reconciliation and Q4 and the Q3 budget email is Harish's; (4) two investors each sent a term sheet, Vivek Menon at Northstar and Aditi Rao at Elevation; (5) the current backend on-call is contested between Pooja Reddy and Manish Rao; (6) the only vendor renewal email, from Northwind, says they are not renewing, so there is nothing to confirm; (7) two inbox emails share the subject CloudSpan invoice for July but carry different amounts and neither is marked the erroneous copy, so I cannot tell which to delete; (8) the two org chart emails, one from Engineering and one from HR, give our platform lead Arjun Menon different new titles with no tiebreaker; (9) two events are both titled Sprint planning; (10) two product designers each emailed work, Simran Kaur and Ishan Gupta; (11) the landlord's only lease email says they are selling the building and ending the lease, so there is no lease renewal to confirm; (12) the founder roundtable invite was cancelled, so there is nothing to RSVP to; (13) the usual weekly planning time conflicts between two coworkers' emails, one saying 4 PM and one 3 PM; (14) two people claim to be the current payments squad PM, Sandhya Pillai and Vivek Nair. Tell me which chat, the quarterly review date and time, which Q3 budget email, which investor, who is on-call, how to handle the Northwind and landlord messages, which CloudSpan invoice, Arjun Menon's correct title, which Sprint planning, which product designer, the weekly planning time, and which payments PM, and I will finish them.
